item.title: University of Florida to stop ‘gender-affirming care’ for students
item.description: University of Florida will no longer help transgender students look like the opposite sex.

item.title: Boston U. teaching hospital glossary says ‘biology’ doesn’t define sex
item.description: Glossary states sex is not fixed, binary The primary teaching hospital of Boston University’s medical school recently updated its “Glossary for Culture Transformation” to include dozens of ideologically loaded terms, a medical advocacy group found. For example, Boston Medical Center’s glossary includes entries for “assigned sex at birth,” “LGBTQIA+,” “fatphobia,” “anti-blackness,” “pansexual,” “misgender,” “transphobia,” and […]

item.title: UCLA staff ‘talk to’ lonely Native American museum pieces at tribe’s request
item.description: UCLA staff are visiting and 'talk[ing] to' Native American artifacts in its museum collection, per tribal request.

item.title: Free speech group defends U. Illinois College Republicans amid uproar over ICE post
item.description: Student group faced backlash for a graphic resembling recent fatal shooting of Alex Pretti.

item.title: Columbia removes ICE recruitment post after faculty and student backlash
item.description: The ad had read 'Help defend the homeland,' seeking to recruit thousands of 'mission critical positions' within the Department of Homeland Security agencies in attendance.

item.title: Lincoln Memorial med school accused of refusing to give Jewish students off for holidays
item.description: The Department of Justice is investigating Lincoln Memorial University after it changed its student handbook to disallow excused absences for religious holidays. Orthodox Jewish students and a rabbi expressed concerns about the change.

item.title: Arizona State U. dean says DEI efforts remain despite rebranding in undercover video
item.description: Federal watchdog group files second complaint against school Arizona State University is facing a new federal complaint alleging it has secretly continued its “diversity, equity, and inclusion” curriculum by rebranding terminology to evade scrutiny. item.title: James Madison U. wants students to learn how to deliberate respectfully
item.description: James Madison University is enhancing its civic education initiatives with a $2.72 million federal grant aimed at promoting reasoned debate and diverse perspectives. The funding is part of a broader Trump administration effort to support civil discourse on college campuses.

item.title: Baylor doc sues after rape allegation, DOJ charges for exposing trans procedures
item.description: Biden's DOJ and his colleagues targeted him. Now he's fighting back with a lawsuit.

item.title: Former UCSB student government president sues school alleging antisemitic harassment
item.description: The lawsuit alleges student was 'victim of repeated and systematic assaults and other abuse by a horde of antisemitic instigators on campus.'
